During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''cousin''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] assumed control of the company [[Quintad Orbital Manufacturing]] after Tarkin departed from his post as an executive at QOM in [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], to become the [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].
